content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Cary

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: The PMP credential requires a secondary degree plus documented project-management experience, or a high school diploma with additional experience. Review PMI's official requirements to confirm your education and work history meet the threshold before enrolling in formal training.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Bootcamp. Our online format accommodates Cary's working professionals, combining interactive instruction, real-world case studies, and guided practice across multiple sessions. No travel or scheduling conflicts—learn from your location on your timeline.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing the 35-hour course, submit your PMP application directly to PMI with proof of your education and project experience. Pay the associated exam fee once PMI approves your credentials. Our team provides guidance on documentation and the submission process.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy provides focused exam-preparation support, including practice questions, strategy sessions, and confidence-building resources. Schedule your PMP exam through PMI's testing partner when you feel ready. Most candidates complete the exam within weeks of finishing the bootcamp.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After certification, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) across a three-year renewal cycle to keep your PMP active. Granite PM Academy and PMI offer numerous pathways—continuing education, project work, volunteer activities, and mentoring all count toward your maintenance requirement.
